reached_sql:
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress, MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM aka_name AS an
JOIN char_name AS chn ON an.person_id = chn.id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.note = '(voice)' AND ci.person_id = an.person_id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id AND cn.country_code = '[us]'
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%' AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = mi.movie_id AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%' AND t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
JOIN info_type AS it ON it.info = 'release dates' AND it.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id AND n.gender ='f' AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.role ='actress' AND rt.id = ci.role_id
WHERE chn.id = ci.person_role_id
